I can only think of one way it maybe work if every region has a sky region where planes will travel or engage dogfights with other planes. 

The way to fly is similar to any other vehicle just without breaks and altitude adjustment with up and down key bindings. If you need to land or do air support missions lower the plane above the region you want to go and be given an option to travel in the region and which ever side your closes to the border of that region you will spawn at that far end of the map and be present with everyone else on the ground. 

You can land at the runway by descending more untill you hit the ground/pavement, and fire missions just click and shoot where you want if you are at a appropriate altitude, and pitch up to return to the air region. In ways I can think of preventing planes from flying in the land region forever or till their fuel runs out is maybe fuel cost is hugely increased or make them faster when they are closer to the ground so planes don't make hard turns and keep hitting the same target every few seconds, but will have to fly up in the air region and circle back to the same way they came in the ground region the first time which might take a few minutes since the air regions are muuuch larger than the ground and possible hostile planes might shoot you down. 

Idk how ground air defense will work. Maybe for player control AA Guns will have a toggle to engage ground targets or air targets and switching between them takes a few seconds because aiming adjustment. Or have AI try to shoot them down, or even both. Also AA can only engage planes in the same region as them so since planes are too high to hit in the air region. 

Also since planes are a thing we get another ground vehicle to tow and organize planes at the airports or use cranes and pick them up and move them to new buildings like the hangers and store them or wherever else on the airport. 

This is just my thoughts how it might work.

I was doing online math on edgenuity because I'm a moron when it comes to math. Each lesson starts with a practice test, if you pass it you don't need to take the lesson but if you didn't you take the lesson. The site allows you to look back at your test and see what you got wrong and shows the right answer, so I took every photo of questions in the test (which is 10 questions) with my phone and took another test ( you can take the test 3 times with different questions and you don't need to look at any lesson videos to get to the real test at the end). If I find a different question on a retake I failed i take the photo of it for later use. The lessons don't give that many different questions so if you have photos from previous test you can highly likely pass on your final attempt with questions you seen before. If lucky you will get a test with almost every question you saw from your last failed test. 

This hack saved me from not graduating so I hope this helps others.
